label: Swaps: tilapia + basil, 100 m2, Netherlands glasshouse: architecture, heating and part swaps side by side
_how_to_edit: Each option is a patch on the base build (dicts merge, lists and values replace). Part alternatives from the catalog are added automatically (include_component_alternatives).

base._location: Wage and electricity come from data/scenarios/unit_configuration_candidates_v0.json (locations block).
base._structure_area_basis: planning_area_m2_uvi_ratio (grow area x UVI land ratio) or minimum_area_m2 (grow area + equipment footprint).

options.label: Media bed with expanded clay instead of DWC raft
options.note: Fish and feed drop to 25% of the raft rate (SRAC 454 factor, low confidence). No sourced media-bed basil yield, so cost per kg is n/a; bed container not priced.

options.label: NFT with uPVC channels instead of DWC raft
options.note: Yield = DWC yield x 0.83-0.95 (Blunk 2023, Pasch 2021; candidate). Channel metres per m2 not sourced, so channel cost is a gap. No NL biofilter media price, so the separate biofilter NFT needs is a gap too.

options.label: Air-water heat pump instead of gas boiler (same heat demand)
options.note: Heat pump lifetime is not sourced, so its build cost per year is left out. Gas boiler price is also missing in the base.

options.label: Unheated glasshouse (heating off)
options.note: Upper bound on what heating costs. Yield stays at the heated value, which an unheated NL house would not reach in winter (not modelled).

options.label: Existing building instead of a new glasshouse
options.note: Heating off too: heat demand is per m2 of greenhouse. A building would need lights, which are not in the catalog.
